description: This file defines the AccessMcpResourceTool class, a tool for accessing MCP resources, including methods for executing the tool, parsing parameters, and handling partial requests.

classes.name: AccessMcpResourceTool
classes.description: A class extending BaseTool to facilitate access to MCP resources, including parameter parsing, execution, and partial handling.

methods.name: parseLegacy
methods.description: Parses legacy parameters into AccessMcpResourceParams object.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the tool to access MCP resource, handling approval, errors, and response formatting.

methods.name: handlePartial
methods.description: Handles partial requests for the tool, preparing partial messages for user prompts.
